prompt: In this cinematic film still, a weathered shipyard dock stretches into the misty distance under a grey sky. On the far left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning against a rusted metal railing. Next to him sits a small brown dog with perked ears, gazing intently at the water. In the center foreground, a woman in a blue raincoat holds a rolled-up blueprint tightly against her chest. She is pointing toward a massive steel hull that dominates the background. Beside her, a man in a red scarf looks at the blueprint with furrowed brows. To their right, a young apprentice in orange overalls hands a silver wrench to an older mechanic with grease-stained hands. The mechanic takes the tool while sitting on a wooden crate near the edge of the pier. Behind them, a white seagull perches on a coiled rope, watching the exchange. Further back, a black cat sleeps atop a stack of shipping containers. A rusty anchor lies half-buried in the mud near the water's edge. There is no bright sunlight illuminating the scene. There is no modern digital equipment visible anywhere on the dock.
